//: Ported from CDDA. CDDA's newer material-object form is flattened to plain strings and its use_action arrays to strings, both being shapes CSE's loader does not read. aim_game was left out of this batch: its magazine well restricts on BATTERY_LIGHT and BATTERY_ULTRA_LIGHT, which CSE does not declare, and an undeclared flag is erased on load, so the well would silently accept anything.
description: A board game about farming, in which players sow fields, raise livestock and try to feed a growing family.  Deceptively cut-throat.
An ancient board game of capture, played on a grid of crossing lines.  Older than chess, and rather less forgiving.

//2: Loot only. CDDA crafts this from mercury, which CSE has neither as an item nor as a material, and CSE already has a craftable plastic thermometer, so this is the glass variant rather than a replacement for it.
description: A device used to measure temperature.  This one is made entirely of glass, with a thread of mercury sealed inside.  Fragile, but it needs no batteries.

//3: CDDA states the material as objects with portions, cotton 9 to cardboard 1; CSE reads a plain list, so the ordering carries the sense instead.
description: A soft target for archery, consisting of tightly-packed cloth stuffed into a cardboard box.  Arrows sink in and pull back out without much damage.
